canonical_project: Kai Shin Digital Infrastructure Satsumasendai AI Data Center
owner: Kai Shin Digital Infrastructure Inc.; CDIB Capital Group; Shinetsu Science Industry
notes: Satsumasendai City says it signed a location agreement with Kai Shin Digital Infrastructure on July 18, 2026 for an AI data center in Circular Park Kyushu, starting with demonstration operation and expanding in stages to a cumulative 350MW; planned investment about 850B yen.
